item.title: Asterion 0.9.1
item.description:
Live football plays smoothly in Asterion's own player.

  • A match starts quickly on a light picture and steps up to a sharper one as your connection allows.
  • Matches play a little behind live, so a hiccup in the broadcast passes without stopping the picture.
  • Camel Live streams play in Asterion's own player, alongside StreamFree.
  • If a stream stops working, the match moves on to the next one by itself.
  • Films and episodes without extra subtitles play in Asterion's own player.

item.title: Asterion 0.9.0
item.description:
Search everything, and title pages with the cast, what's next and where each story comes from.

  • Search on Home finds people, characters, stories, films, series, anime, manga, novels and matches, with your own titles first and where you are in them. Name an episode, like "One Piece 1100" or "Breaking Bad s3 e7", and a Play card starts it.
  • Your reader theme, typeface, text size and line spacing, Listen voice and speed, manga page layout, skip intros, weekly goal and alerts follow your account to every device you sign in on.
  • The reader's themes are System, Parchment and Night, and System follows your Mac's light or dark appearance.
  • Settings has the reader's theme and typeface, manga pages, notifications and privacy, with the Literary, Classic and Accessible typefaces.
  • Film, series and anime pages show wide artwork, the title's logo, a tagline and the age rating.
  • See the cast and characters with their photos, and open anyone's page to see what else they're known for.
  • More like this, the rest of a film series and an anime's watch order sit on every page.
  • Series and anime show when the next episode airs, and each episode shows its air date and length.
  • An anime based on a manga or novel leads to it with Read the manga or Read the novel, and manga and novel pages lead to their anime.
  • Anime Discover opens on this season's top shows.
  • Choose the picture quality in the player, and the version you pick is the one that plays.
  • A stream's subtitles and More subtitles are in the player's subtitles menu by language, in time with the picture, in your caption style and in Picture in Picture.
  • Films and episodes start on the first stream that works, and anime episodes start quickly.
  • A picture shows whole until you fill the window for that title, and Asterion remembers your choice.

item.title: Asterion 0.8.0
item.description:
More subtitles, a short welcome, and tips that show where things are.

  • More subtitles to choose from for every film and episode.
  • Match pages list the streams that play straight in Asterion's own player.
  • A short welcome on first launch asks once about notifications, so alerts for new episodes, chapters and your matches reach you.
  • Short tips point out Listen, subtitles, Continue, saving and downloads the first time you need them.
  • Every title page saves to your library with the same bookmark button.

item.title: Asterion 0.7.1
item.description:
Steadier chapter downloads, and match alerts only for the matches you choose.

  • Chapters download in the background while you keep using Asterion, without it closing.
  • Match notifications come only for the matches you set a reminder for or follow.

item.title: Asterion 0.7.0
item.description:
Know when the shows you follow have new episodes.

  • Get an alert when an anime or series you've saved has new episodes, while Asterion is open. Click it to go straight to the show.
  • Turn these alerts on or off with New episodes in Account.

item.title: Asterion 0.6.2
item.description:
Football with lineups and stats, alerts for the matches that matter, and your choice of picture quality.

  • Every match shows its competition and crest. Matches that haven't started show their kickoff time.
  • Lineups appear on a pitch in each team's formation, with goals, cards and substitutions marked on the players, alongside team stats and a timeline of the match.
  • Get a kickoff alert for popular matches without clicking Remind me, and updates for lineups, goals and full time on the matches you follow.
  • Choose a stream's quality from the player, or set a default in Settings.
  • Choose which kinds of content Auto Download keeps ready.
  • A reminder to pick up where you left off, and alerts when a download finishes or a new version of Asterion is ready. Each alert has its own switch in Settings.
  • Twenty studios and streaming services to browse in Movies & TV, including HBO Max, Hulu, A24 and Studio Ghibli.

item.title: Asterion 0.6.1
item.description:
A steadier player, and downloads that keep themselves ready.

  • Films, series and episodes keep playing smoothly as you start them, switch servers and close the player.
  • Auto Download in Settings keeps the next chapters and episodes of what you're reading and watching downloaded, and clears them once you've finished. Your own downloads stay.
  • Turn Auto Download on or off for any title from that title's downloads.

item.title: Asterion 0.6.0
item.description:
Downloads you can count on, a fuller player, and Asterion that keeps working without a connection.

  • One Download button on every title. Pick the next few, everything unread, everything, or a season, and see the size and the free space first.
  • Pause a download and resume it whenever you like, even days later. Downloads wait out a lost connection and carry on by themselves.
  • Download all gets every chapter, even on the longest novels, and chapters download several at a time.
  • Keep it ready keeps the next few chapters downloaded and removes the ones you've read.
  • Films and series play and download at their full picture quality.
  • When one source for an episode won't play or download, another takes over.
  • The player shows Up next, lets you choose subtitles and playback speed, has a sleep timer, and works from Now Playing.
  • Without a connection, your downloads, the pages and covers you've seen, and search over what's on this Mac all still work. Library changes and feedback are kept and sent once you're back online.
  • Film and series descriptions tell you about the story and nothing else.
  • Choose whether to share how you use Asterion to help improve it. It never includes your searches or the words you read.

item.title: Asterion 0.5.1
item.description:
Sign in and create an account from Account on any Mac.

  • Signing in and creating an account open the sign-in window as expected.
  • Everything in 0.5.0: read manga, manhwa and webtoons with your place following you to every device, and novel places that reach your other devices within moments.

item.title: Asterion 0.5.0
item.description:
Read manga, manhwa and webtoons alongside your novels, with your place following you to every device.

  • Find manga under Popular, Latest updates and Genres, or search for a title.
  • Read in a continuous scroll or page by page, with pinch to zoom. The next chapter carries on when you reach the end of one.
  • Search a title's chapters or jump straight to a chapter number.
  • Download chapters to read offline.
  • Pick up a manga or a novel on your iPhone or iPad at the same page, and hand off between devices while you read.
  • Your place in a novel reaches your other devices within moments, and never goes back to an earlier spot.
  • Finished manga count toward Finished on your profile, and manga appear on Home.
  • Skip the intro, recap and credits on films and series.
  • Episodes start on a stream that plays, even when the usual one is down.
  • Anime show only real subtitle tracks.
  • Sign in once after this update. Asterion then stays signed in through later updates without asking for your Mac password.
